digest.component_or_area: LLM prompt caching warning / anthropic integration
propositions: warn_if_cache_ineffective fires on every call with zero cache counters regardless of input size, including sub-floor prompts below 4096 tokens where caching cannot work
the warning predicate lacks a lower bound and contradicts the codebase's own design invariant that CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS=4096 defines the minimum cacheable prefix
sub-floor calls generate ~20 false-positive warnings per rebar review-plan run, creating alarm fatigue that obscures genuine cache defects when they occur
the cache floor constant is defined in pass1.py but the warning check in structured_run.py has no access to it, leading to potential duplicate definitions
the warning should gate on input_tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS to distinguish 'sub-floor prompt that cannot cache' from 'cacheable prompt that failed to cache'
once fixed, a full gate run with working cache should emit zero warnings for below-floor calls while retaining detection of above-floor cache failures
